acceptance_criteria: A `Constraint` enum (or equivalent) with variants: `Coincident` (point–point), `Horizontal` and `Vertical` (line, or two points), `Fixed` (point fixed at x, y), `Distance` (point–point, value > 0), `Radius` and `Diameter` (circle/arc, value > 0).
A `Sketch`-level API to add geometry and constraints, build the combined residual vector and Jacobian, and call `solve`.
Each constraint has an analytic Jacobian; a test per constraint compares it to a forward-difference Jacobian within 1e-5 at a non-trivial point.

Solve tests (tolerance 1e-8 on constrained quantities): (a) a line from (0,0) to (3,1) with Horizontal solves to equal y values; (b) Vertical likewise on x; (c) two points with Coincident end at the same position; (d) Fixed puts a point at (2, −1); (e) Distance 5 between two points gives |p1−p2| = 5 ± 1e-8; (f) Radius 4 and Diameter 8 on a circle both give radius 4 ± 1e-8.

Combined test: a rectangle of 4 lines with coincident corners, horizontal/vertical sides, one corner Fixed at (0,0), width Distance 40 and height Distance 25, starting from a perturbed (≤ 20% off) initial guess, converges and gives corners (0,0), (40,0), (40,25), (0,25) within 1e-8.
Invalid input (non-positive distance/radius, unknown geometry id) returns an error, not a panic.
No `unsafe`; no new dependencies; doc comments cite any non-obvious formulation.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M2-03: Constraints: coincident, horizontal, vertical, fixed, distance, radius/diameter
